name: prompts-library
tagline: Your own prompt workspace — saved, versioned, deployed.
description: Save, organise, and deploy your own prompts. Versioned, searchable, and deployable to chat composer and slash commands. All prompts are stored server-side and sync across devices.
shortDescription: Save, version, and deploy your own prompts.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Save any prompt you write — stored on the server, never in your browser
Full version history with restore to any prior version
Organise with tags, categories, and free-text search
Deploy a prompt to the chat composer in one click
Import / export your prompt collection as JSON
Shared visibility controls: private or org-wide

save.name: Save & Version
save.description: Every edit is auto-versioned. Restore any prior version instantly.

search.name: Search & Filter
search.description: Full-text search by name, description, body, or tags. Filter by category or visibility.

deploy.name: Deploy to Composer
deploy.description: Push any prompt directly into the chat composer or register as a slash command.

exportImport.name: Export & Import
exportImport.description: Back up your prompts as JSON or import from another Quox org.

sharing.name: Org Sharing
sharing.description: Mark prompts as org-visible to share with teammates without copy-paste.

changes: P7.E.1: Replaced scraped third-party prompt corpus with user-owned library
All prompts now stored server-side (auth service SQLite)
REST API: CRUD + search + import/export + migration from localStorage
Removed 75 scraped/leaked system prompts from Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Devin, Windsurf, Replit (legal/optical risk)
Initial release (DEPRECATED - used scraped third-party prompts)
